object.description: Steps: Run the JUnit tests of ElevationGainTest, which call elevationGain, the function that the session uses on its recorded path. Expected: Altitudes 100, 105, 112 and 120 m give 20 m of gain; 100, 110, 90 and 120 m give 40 m; changes of 1 m or less give 0 m; fixes without altitude give 0 m.
